scope: Files specified by the instrument guide and named analytical products. A shared ledger can be updated in more than one stage. Reading URLs resolve relative to the stage page.

groups.purpose: The model the community coders will read
groups.description: handoff-D/MODEL.md explains the model. VOCABULARY.json lists valid identifiers; LADDER.md links them to evidence. VERSION names the frozen model. RETURN-D.md specifies the local account and adaptation record to return.

groups.purpose: Each community's task and the handler's brief
groups.description: handoff-D/tasks/<sub>/TASK.md gives the task beside that community's documents. tasks/index.tsv lists tasks and sizes. HANDLER.md defines dispatch, checks and how to report a missing return.
verdict-D/ contains the separate packets for judging fit. RETURN-D2v.md specifies the verdicts and supporting evidence readers must provide.

Sections 7 and 8 of prior.md record the distance and evidence rules. MODEL-D1.md supplies the prose model used in the handoff. EXPECTATIONS-D1.jsonl supplies the predictions, sealed as out/sealed/EXPECTATIONS.jsonl . notes-D1.md records checks and limits; handback-D1.md records the handoff.
